title: Nutty Silky Syrian Lamb Flatbread
description: This herbal and silky Syrian dish features lamb and shaoxing wine, made with a long fermentation dough and ayurvedic tamasic friendly ingredients, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the warm water and yeast, letting it sit for 5 minutes until the yeast is activated.
Add the flour, salt, and sumac to the bowl, mixing until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it ferment in a warm place for 2 hours.
Punch down the dough and divide it into 4 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium high heat, cooking the lamb until it is browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the shaoxing wine to the skillet, cooking until the liquid is almost completely evaporated.
Place a spoonful of the lamb mixture onto the center of each dough circle, topping with a sprinkle of parsley and walnuts.
Fold the dough over the filling, forming a half moon shape, and bake for 15 minutes until the bread is golden brown.
